thread:
sarah-sales: Heads up — Raj from DataCypher reports the Dedicated POC GPU pool keeps failing to come up. He sees AZ quota errors and 429s when hitting the reserved endpoint. Can we swarm?

deploy-bot: pool-create failed id=pc-789 status=ERROR reason=QuotaExceeded: Requested 8 GPUs but only 0 available in us-west-2a

raj-client: getting repeated 429s after the create attempt as well: "429 Too Many Requests: token_rate_limit". We retried a few times, no luck.

devon-eng: can you paste the pool config (region/az pins + reservation type)? also which GPU shape?

sarah-sales: here's the body they used:
```json
{
  "region": "us-west-2",
  "azAffinity": ["us-west-2a"],
  "gpuType": "A100-80GB",
  "count": 8,
  "reservationType": "reserved"
}
```

lee-infra: looks like two issues: 1) us-west-2a is very capacity constrained for A100-80GB right now; locking azAffinity to a single AZ causes provisioning failures. 2) the 429s are token-rate throttles from the reserved endpoint because retries are being fired in a tight loop on our side. Recommend: remove strict azAffinity (allow regionFallback), or request fallback to 2b/2c; temporarily reduce requested size to 4 to get POC running; throttle client retries. I'll open a quota request with the cloud provider.

maya-cs: Raj — are you ok if we try fallback to us-west-2b for the POC? On pricing: reserved pool price depends on commit months + shape. I can share a quick estimate once we confirm shape/region.

raj-client: fallback to 2b is ok for the POC. Security team requires BYOK (KMS) and audit logs shipped to our S3 — can you confirm?

devon-eng: BYOK supported. We'll need your KMS ARN and we can enable audit streaming to your S3 bucket. I'll add a step to the runbook.

lee-infra: I'm making the change now: removing azAffinity, enabling regionFallback and lowering initial count to 4 to unblock. Redeploying pool and spacing retries out to avoid token throttles.

deploy-bot: pool-create retried id=pc-789 attempt=2 status=IN_PROGRESS

deploy-bot: pool-create succeeded id=pc-789 status=READY nodes=4 region=us-west-2b shape=A100-80GB

sarah-sales: Nice — thanks team :tada: Raj, I'll send the updated pricing estimate and the security checklist (BYOK steps + audit S3 config). @maya-cs will follow up on SOW / billing details.

maya-cs: I'll draft an SOW addendum for the reduced initial commit and include a path to scale to 8 once quota confirmed.

raj-client: confirmed pool usable, thanks everyone. We'll send KMS ARN and S3 info via the secure intake form.

sarah-sales: moving to post-POC follow-ups: quota bump ticket link (internal): https://redwood.internal/tickets/CR-4521 and cloud request id 987654. Keep me posted on ETA for capacity bump.

lee-infra: noted. Opening cloud provider support case now, cc @devon-eng for logs.

devon-eng: logging note for the runbook — if you see the quota error, check instance shape availability first and avoid tight client retry loops. Example failure snippet:
```
ERROR: QuotaExceeded - Requested 8 units A100-80GB in us-west-2a.
ClientRetries: 12 within 30s -> triggers token_rate_limit 429s.
```

sarah-sales: thanks all — I'll update the DealOps thread with the new pool id and the pricing estimate. :thumbsup:
